brief: Long wood-frame granary and machine building about 36 ft wide and 90 ft long, re-clad in white-painted vertical corrugated steel, under a low side-gabled roof of grey standing-seam metal with deep eaves. A central drive aisle runs through with wide open doorways in both gable ends; along the side a ragged open bay, a man door with steel steps and pipe rails, and a few small windows. It stands on short rubble-stone piers on the downhill side, with old wheels, doors and scrap stacked around it on a gravel yard.
